subject: Group activity change
text:
Hey,

We need to pivot on tomorrow’s planning session. I know the walk-and-talk sounded nice while we were booking the café, but the owner just called to say their terrace cannot be used after all because of a delivery blockage. Rather than drag everyone around at the last minute, I think we should keep things simple and meet in the small shared space behind the studio instead. It is a little cramped, but the table is long enough for laptops, notebooks, and all the snacks we planned to bring. If anyone already promised to join outside, let them know gently and give them the new room. I can still arrive early to set up the whiteboard and coffee. Just tell me if you would rather push the start back fifteen minutes, because I want the team to feel comfortable. No big fuss, just a tiny shuffle. If the weather is nice, we can finish with a short break nearby once the main work is done, but nobody must stay late.
